player_prompt.intro:
I bɛna tali {N} kɛlɛbaga sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, i bɛna ta [accept] ka kɛlɛ kɔnɔɔni *sɔgɔma*, walima [continue] ka taa kɛlɛ kɔnɔɔni sɔgɔma ka wari dɔɔni.
Ni i mɛnna kɛlɛ kɔnɔɔni sɔgɔ, i bɛna kɛlɛ laban kosɛbɛ.
I bɛna sɔrɔ (ka dɔnɛ = 1) **kɔnɔ** ni kɛlɛ i sɔgɔma bɛɛ yɛlɛma kosɛbɛ.

outcome.summary: I sɔgɔma kɛlɛ {value} kɔnɔ wari {draw_num}/{N}. Kɛlɛ kɔnɔɔni kosɛbɛ bɛ {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: O tun ye koo ɲuman yɛrɛ lo ye!
outcome.not_max: Nka, o tɛ se ka kɛ.
